title: Isaac and Rebekah Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Isaac and Rebekah Bible Crossword
description: Solve an Isaac and Rebekah Bible crossword: the servant at the well, the camels, the twins, and the birthright. KJV clues from Genesis 24–25, free on iOS.
prose: Abraham sends his eldest servant back to his own country to find a wife for Isaac, and the servant prays for a sign at a well: let her be the one who offers to water the camels too. Isaac and Rebekah covers that errand and what followed — the bracelets, the journey, Isaac meditating in the field at eventide, and the twins that struggled together within her.
It sits in the Medium tier because the chapter is long and its details are easy to blur. The closing verse is Isaac's prayer, and the answer to it.

clues.text: Where the servant waited and prayed for a sign
Beasts Rebekah offered to draw water for
The elder twin, a cunning hunter
What Esau sold for a mess of pottage

verseText: And Isaac intreated the LORD for his wife, because she was barren: and the LORD was intreated of him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.
